description: Forged and mismatched evidence: a changed byte, an edited source, a reworded quote, shifted or byte/UTF-16 offsets, CRLF-normalized hashes, path escapes and unknown ids must fail validation, while CRLF bytes, emoji offsets and a repeated quote stay valid and a consistent forgery shows what a hash cannot prove.

validation.name: base
validation.note: the dataset as recorded: CRLF email, Chinese quote after an emoji, quote at its second occurrence

validation.name: hash-one-digit
validation.note: one hex digit of the recorded SHA-256 changed

validation.name: edited-source
validation.note: the cited file says 'approved' where the hashed bytes said 'rejected'

validation.name: forged-quote
validation.error: quote does not match recorded span: q-f03
validation.note: right file and hash, but the recorded quote says 'approved'

validation.name: shifted-span
validation.error: quote does not match recorded span: q-f03
validation.note: the span is off by one character

validation.name: byte-offsets
validation.error: quote does not match recorded span: q-f02
validation.note: offsets counted in UTF-8 bytes instead of characters

validation.name: utf16-offsets
validation.error: quote does not match recorded span: q-f02
validation.note: offsets counted in UTF-16 code units; the emoji before the quote is a surrogate pair

validation.name: crlf-normalized
validation.note: hash and offsets taken from an LF-converted copy of a CRLF file

validation.name: path-escape
validation.note: the path leaves the dataset directory

validation.name: missing-file
validation.note: the cited file does not exist

validation.name: directory-path
validation.error: evidence is not a regular file

validation.name: duplicate-id
validation.note: two manifest lines with one id

validation.name: not-utf8
validation.note: a Latin-1 file with a matching hash

validation.name: unknown-evidence
validation.error: event f03 cites unknown evidence: q-f03-signed
validation.note: an event cites an id the manifest does not have

validation.name: consistent-forgery
validation.note: a forged file with its own correct hash and span loads: a hash proves the quote is in those bytes, not that the bytes are authentic

Retention policy.note: request, risk, reject, then the customer's reconsideration.
